$comment: NEW-52 exponentialTalk spike numbers. Synthetic clips: the 20 phrases of data/phrases.json spoken by Kokoro (en) and Qwen3-TTS 1.7B (de + en); no human recordings yet (scripts/record.sh). WER is scored against the spoken form; identifiers like 'E X P twelve forty two' count word by word, which penalises engines that normalise them to 'exp1242'.
machine: mint (Linux Mint 22, i9 32 threads, RTX 4090 24 GB, PipeWire, Arctis Nova 7)

tts.engine: kokoro v1.0 (sherpa-onnx 2.0, lexicon, no espeak-ng), CPU 4 threads

qwen3_tts_1_7b_q4km_llama_cpp_vulkan.engine: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base Q4_K_M + mmproj Q8_0 (ggml-org), llama-tts b11846, Vulkan on RTX 4090
qwen3_tts_1_7b_q4km_llama_cpp_vulkan.note: llama-tts is not streaming: total = prompt eval + generation + vocoder for the whole utterance; the process wall time includes ~1.5 s of model load per call (a resident worker pays it once). First call on CPU (no -dev) ran at 0.58x realtime.
qwen3_tts_1_7b_q4km_llama_cpp_vulkan.vram_mib_nvidia_smi: 5621-6576 (Vulkan allocates generously; CUDA build and the 0.6B model not measured)
qwen3_tts_1_7b_q4km_llama_cpp_vulkan.german: yes: de clips generated from the spoken forms; quality judged by ear only

nemotron_3_5_transcribe_cpp.engine: nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b Q8_0 (handy-computer GGUF, OpenMDW-1.1), transcribe.cpp (MIT, ggml) CUDA
nemotron_3_5_transcribe_cpp.offline_clip_realtime_factor: 14-30x cold per process (73-126 ms for 1.1-3.7 s clips), 49x warm (-r 5: 33 ms for 1.6 s)
nemotron_3_5_transcribe_cpp.vocabulary_biasing: not supported by this backend in transcribe.cpp ('model parakeet does not support vocabulary')

nemotron_3_5_onnx_fp16_ort.engine: soniqo ONNX FP16 export (encoder 1.24 GB), onnxruntime 1.31 Python, zero caches, one 320 ms chunk
nemotron_3_5_onnx_fp16_ort.note: an unoptimised probe (dummy cache shapes, no IO binding): the ONNX path is near real time at best; the ggml runtime above is the measured production path

channels.method: pw-record -P '{ stream.capture.sink=true }' --target <sink> per source, two recorders at once
channels.result: two 16 kHz mono clips of 3.86 s each, peaks 0.52/0.54, onsets 609 ms and 1460 ms = the 0.8 s play offset within 50 ms; per-app capture = the same call on the app's own node

os_voice_linux.result: spoke all 20 phrases through the headset; Danny: 'sounds really bad'. Not usable as the Linux fallback voice. Time to first audio not captured: the speech-dispatcher stream could not be routed to a recordable sink in the time box.

vad_knob.min_silence_0_5_s: end-of-utterance lag 500 ms on every clip
